legal_page.intro: Legal information about this website and how your personal data is processed.
legal_page.draft: Provisional text, to be legally validated by AGRI'SUP before going live.
legal_page.database_text: Form data is stored in a PostgreSQL database hosted by Neon, on servers located in the European Union (Frankfurt, Germany). Email notifications are sent through Resend.
legal_page.data_collected: Data collected: through the contact form (name, email or phone, subject, message) and the pre-registration form (last name, first name, phone, optional email, city, level of education, desired program and academic year, optional message).
legal_page.data_purpose: Purpose: this data is only used to answer your requests and process your pre-registration. It is never sold or used for advertising.
legal_page.data_basis: Legal basis: your consent, given by ticking the box in each form.
legal_page.data_recipients: Recipients: authorised AGRI'SUP staff, and the technical providers needed to run the website (hosting, database, email delivery).
legal_page.data_security: Security: exchanges are encrypted (HTTPS); IP addresses used to limit abusive submissions are never stored in plain text.
legal_page.rights_text: In accordance with Law No. 2013-015 of 21 May 2013 on the protection of personal data in the Republic of Mali, you have the right to access, correct, object to and delete your data. To exercise these rights, contact AGRI'SUP through the Contact page. You may also contact the Personal Data Protection Authority (APDP).
legal_page.cookies_locale: Language: a technical cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) remembers your language choice.
legal_page.cookies_theme: Theme: your light or dark theme choice is saved in your browser's local storage and is not transmitted.
legal_page.cookies_youtube: Video: the presentation video is only loaded from YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com domain) if you click "play". YouTube may then set its own trackers.
legal_page.cookies_maps: Map: the Google Maps map is only loaded if you click "Show the map".
legal_page.ip_text: The content of this website (texts, logo, visuals) belongs to AGRI'SUP unless otherwise stated. Any reproduction without permission is prohibited.
legal_page.credits: Icons: Heroicons (MIT licence) and Font Awesome Free (CC BY 4.0 licence, fontawesome.com). Carousel: Embla Carousel (MIT licence).
